title.zh: 建屋发展（职总英康保险合作社）命令
title.en: Housing and Development (NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Housing and Development (NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited) Order.

heading.en: NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited may purchase HDB flat

text.en: 2. The NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited, a body corporate established under the Co-operative Societies Act (Cap. 62), shall be entitled to purchase from the Board the flats comprised in Block 5 Changi Village Road which are set out in the First Schedule, and sold subject to the provisions of Part IV of the Act.

heading.en: Modifications to Part IV of Act

text.en: 3. The provisions of Part IV of the Act shall apply in relation to the NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited with the modifications set out in the Second Schedule.

SECOND SCHEDULE
Paragraph 3
1. Sections 47, 48, 48B, 49, 52 and 56(1)(b), (j) and (l) of the Act shall not apply to the NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited.
2. For the avoidance of doubt, the exemptions in paragraph 1 shall not extend to any assignee or purchaser of any such flat from the NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited.
[G.N. No. S 540/2008]
